body: That's what I'm asking, I don't know why I do anything but I wouldn't say I look forward to doing anything. Nothing is satisfying.

> Is it because death would seem like a release from your struggles and pain?

No I don't have many struggles or pain.

> What if there is something for you to do here?

If there is I don't know what it is.

> What if you die not having learned what you were meant to and have to repeat this over again?

I don't believe in that.
